neighbours.label: Verb of speaking used as a trailing speech tag after unquoted reported content ('…, she said'); weaker on 'talk' / 'communicate'. The other side of the + pole, which takes inner speech ('he thought', 'to himself')
fire: The bridge would stay shut until spring, the mayor said.
Nobody had seen the dog since Tuesday, she said.
Four, perhaps five miles to the next village, the farmer said.
The shipment was already on its way, he said.
It would rain before evening, the old woman said.
The keys had been on the table all along, she said.
There was no money left in the fund, the treasurer said.
The train had left an hour early, he said.
quiet: The bridge would stay shut until spring, the mayor thought.
Nobody had seen the dog since Tuesday, she realized.
Four, perhaps five miles to the next village, the farmer guessed to himself.
The shipment was already on its way, he hoped.
It would rain before evening, the old woman thought to herself.
The keys had been on the table all along, she remembered.
There was no money left in the fund, the treasurer knew.
The train had left an hour early, he supposed.

notes: Card: ' communicate', ' talk', ' said', ' talking'; + pole ' thought', ' himself'. Probes were weak on talk/communicate (0.03-0.13); the trailing tag 'X, she said' gave 0.49, 0.22, 0.11; 'she thought' / 'he knew' 0.01. Label narrowed to the tag; it may well fail on the median.
